content.text: In Venezuela, creators face a significant infrastructure barrier when it comes to [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/accepting-bitcoin-ebook-sales-step-step-deployment-guide-5|accepting]] crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-what-nobody-tells-2|Payment Infrastructure]]s – no Stripe or other major payment gateways are available, leaving them reliant on restrictive and expensive solutions. This is a problem that can be solved with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-google-apps-script-digital-commerce-8|COREMERCH guide to architecture]], but the choice of solution can have a significant impact on the creator's business. By choosing the right infrastructure, creators can access a wider range of payment options, reduce fees, and improve the overall user experience for their customers. But how do they make this choice? What options are available, and which one is the best choice for Venezuelan creators? In this post, we'll explore the different options for accepting crypto payments in Venezuela and provide guidance on which one to choose based on your specific situation.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

The most popular options for accepting crypto payments in Venezuela are NOWPayments, Binance P2P, and USDT on Tron. NOWPayments offers a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT, and supports both on-chain and off-chain transactions. Binance P2P, on the other hand, allows users to buy and sell cryptocurrencies directly with each other, with a wide range of fiat currencies supported, including naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10, making it an attractive option for creators looking to reduce their transaction fees.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Each of these options handles restricted countries differently. NOWPayments is available in most countries, including Venezuela, but requires creators to comply with local regulations and obtain any necessary licenses. Binance P2P, on the other hand, is available in a wide range of countries, including Venezuela, but has strict Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) policies in place to prevent illicit activity. USDT on Tron is available globally, with no restrictions in place, but creators should be aware that this may not comply with local regulations in some countries.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

In terms of payment speed, USDT on Tron is the clear winner, settling in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. NOWPayments and Binance P2P offer more variable payment speeds, depending on the specific payment method and network congestion. In terms of fees, NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee for transactions, while Binance P2P charges a range of fees depending on the specific payment method and market conditions. USDT on Tron, on the other hand, charges a fee under $0.10 per transaction.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Creators in Ethiopia, Cameroon, Tanzania, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, and the Philippines face a compounded challenge: not only are conventional payment platforms unavailable, but local banking infrastructure may add additional friction to receiving international transfers through alternative channels. Crypto payments remove this layer entirely. A seller in Addis Ababa and a seller in Amsterdam receive USDT transactions through the same NOWPayments infrastructure, at the same speed, with the same 0.5% fee. The blockchain has no knowledge of which country a wallet is located in. The webhook fires to both backends identically. Geographic neutrality is not a feature — it is the fundamental property of how blockchains work.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture should creators choose based on their specific situation? If they're looking for a fast and cheap payment option, USDT on Tron is the clear winner. If they're looking for a more advanced set of features, including automatic webhook notifications and instant delivery of digital products, NOWPayments or USDT on Tron may be a better choice. If they're looking for a solution that supports a wide range of fiat currencies, including naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees, Binance P2P may be a better option.
